faq.question: Can we request your portfolio?
faq.answer: Yes. We'll match a BIM Consultant/Manager to your project and share their CV and relevant case studies.

faq.question: What does a BIM Consultant do?
faq.answer: Define the EIR, prepare the BEP, set up MIDP/TIDP, govern the CDE, and oversee model QA/QC, coordination, and compliance (ISO 19650, IFC+SG/CORENET X).

faq.question: Can you advise on Autodesk Construction Cloud?
faq.answer: Yes. We support Autodesk Construction Cloud (BIM Collaborate Pro), ProjectWise, Trimble Connect, BIMcollab, and Dalux—setting up environments, permissions, workflows, and approvals.

faq.question: Can you help with CORENET X / IFC+SG submissions?
faq.answer: Yes. We plan workflows, validate models against IFC+SG and local codes, and prepare submission packages. Final checks and submission are by the appointed QP.

faq.question: Do you work on a retainer or project basis? What deliverables do we get?
faq.answer: Both. We offer fixed-scope projects or monthly retainers. Typical deliverables: EIR/BEP, MIDP/TIDP, CDE setup, coordination reports, federated models, 4D/5D/6D models.

faq.question: What do you need to get started?
faq.answer: Provide project brief, latest models/drawings, standards, software versions, milestones, and key contacts. We can audit your setup and deliver targeted training with SOPs.
